t: ff.57 My doctor prescribed a marathon
st: An ancient story of Crocs, health and human limits

sec.t: ff.57.1 Between Greek myths, philosophy and new religions
sec.p: In a few days I'll be on the start line of the Padua Marathon. It'll be my first official one, but during the red-zone lockdown, staying strictly inside my municipality, I'd already covered the distance by running 6 laps of my charming hometown, Gazzaniga.

If you can't run a marathon, your health is shaky. That's the provocation on Twitter from Alan Couzens, an expert performance coach. Replying to a doctor who claims marathons are among the most pointless activities known to humanity, he points out:

sec.t: ff.57.3 Running a (half) marathon in Crocs
sec.p: For a few weeks now, Crocs have officially been worth more than Credit Suisse.
